## Checklist

Before submitting this pull request, please confirm that:

- [ ] I have read the contributing guidelines.
- [ ] This pull request focuses on a specific change or improvement.

- [ ] I have included visual examples where relevant.
- [ ] I have checked that the changes do not unintentionally affect other parts of the project.
